stow.whatsnew.title: What's new in Stow
stow.whatsnew.empty: No release notes are bundled for this version yet.
stow.settings.whats-new.tip: After Stow updates, show a short summary of new features with how-to tips once. Reopen it any time with the button below.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.camera.title: Area camera flies where you look
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.camera.text: The Claim area camera is fixed: it flies in the direction you look, the mouse turns it properly, A/D strafe the right way and your character stays put.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.camera.how.1: W/S fly forward and back (including up and down), A/D strafe, Space/Shift rise and sink, and sprint (Ctrl) flies faster. Your own key bindings are used.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.select.title: Two-step area selection
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.select.text: Selecting an area is now two clear steps: first the footprint, then the height, with live outlines, size and block count.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.select.how.1: Step 1, footprint: fly the camera, left-click one corner block, then right-click the opposite corner. That takes you straight to the height step (Enter works too).
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.select.how.2: Step 2, height: scroll to move the top (hold Alt to move the bottom), then left-click or press Enter to confirm. Backspace goes back to the footprint.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.select.how.3: Clicking again redoes a corner and Backspace undoes the last one. Esc cancels at any time.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.panel.title: Controls panel
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.panel.text: A small panel in Stow's usual style lists the keys and mouse buttons for the current step, using your own key bindings, plus the corners, size and height.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.panel.how.1: Mint means the selection is valid; salmon shows the reason when it is not.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.f1.title: Hide the HUD with F1
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.f1.text: F1 (or your Hide GUI key) now works while you select an area.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.f1.how.1: Press F1 to hide the panel and HUD while you look around; the outlines stay visible.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.whatsnew.title: This screen
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.whatsnew.text: After each update Stow shows what's new once, with short tips like these.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_6.whatsnew.how.1: Reopen it or turn it off in Stow settings → Appearance.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.claim.title: Claim a whole area of storage
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.claim.text: Already have lots of chests, barrels and shulker boxes from before? Mark all unclaimed ones in an area as yours in one go. Needs the updated Stow Companion on the server; storage that already has an owner or is Shared is never changed.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.claim.how.1: Open Storage → Claim area → Fly and select corners.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.claim.how.2: Fly the camera over your storage and select the box; the controls panel shows the keys for each step.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.claim.how.3: On the review screen, press Claim unassigned storage in this box. Esc cancels at any time.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.owners.title: Storage owners and Shared storage
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.owners.text: With the updated companion, newly placed chests, barrels and shulker boxes remember who placed them. This is for organising, not protection.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.owners.how.1: Storage cards show the owner: a player, Shared or Unclaimed.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.owners.how.2: Use the Owner filter in the storage list to show only yours, shared, unclaimed or one player's storage.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.owners.how.3: To change one container, open it and use its card's Rename → Storage owner.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.shulkers.title: Shulker boxes stay up to date
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.shulkers.text: Picking up, moving or replacing shulker boxes no longer leaves old or duplicate entries, and boxes show their own colour in the storage list.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.shulkers.how.1: Nothing to set up. If someone else changed a box while you were away, open it once to refresh it.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.lists.title: Tidier storage list
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.lists.text: Chests and barrels have icons, cards are more compact with up to three columns, text fields have a proper blinking cursor, and the material list no longer covers your potion effects.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.lists.how.1: Open Storage as usual; wider windows show more columns.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.hud.title: Equipment HUD in hotbar order
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.hud.text: Tools and armour in the equipment HUD now follow your hotbar from left to right, then helmet to boots, instead of jumping around by durability.
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.smoother.title: Smoother play
stow.whatsnew.1_0_5.smoother.text: Inventory screens and HUDs do much less repeated work, which helps with lag in big storage setups. Shift-dragging only matching items works correctly again with Mouse Tweaks installed.

stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.stow.title: One Stow screen
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.stow.text: Materials, Storage, Projects and Quick actions are now one screen with a single query bar and three segments: Find, Project and Containers. Lists and details sit side by side on wide screens and stack on small ones.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.stow.how.1: Press Ctrl+K anywhere, or the Stow button beside a container.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.stow.how.2: Ctrl+1, Ctrl+2 and Ctrl+3 switch segments; Esc steps back.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.find.title: Find anything from one box
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.find.text: Find lists matching items with totals, sources and distance, plus containers, actions and projects. Enter makes the nearest container glow. Typing “need 64 glass” sets a project need without opening the project.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.find.how.1: Start with > to list only actions, or # for projects.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.find.how.2: Shift+Enter adds the chosen item to the project.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.project.title: Projects as a table
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.project.text: The Project segment shows Need, Have, Missing and sources for every item, with Missing, All and Done filters. Needs are edited inline, and the detail shows stacks, shulker boxes and where the items are counted.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.project.how.1: Use the project name button to switch, create, rename or delete projects.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.project.how.2: The scope button picks which containers count.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.project.how.3: Ctrl+Z undoes removals, imports and deletions.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.containers.title: Containers and area claims
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.containers.text: Containers can be filtered (In project, Named, Stale), sorted and renamed in place. With the Companion, Claim an area starts the camera directly; V sets the full allowed height and the panel counts the remembered containers inside.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.containers.how.1: F2 renames the chosen container; Space counts it for the project.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.containers.how.2: The server still checks ownership and limits.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.strip.title: A calmer container strip
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.strip.text: Beside containers there are now Sort, Stow, a key legend and Deposit, plus Stop glow while a glow runs. The project strip lists only what is still missing, highlights matching slots and offers Take missing to pull those items into your inventory.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.strip.how.1: Scroll over Sort to change the order; right-click it for options.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.strip.how.2: Take missing never touches pinned slots.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.strip.how.3: The key legend opens by itself for your first three containers.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.hover.title: Find the hovered item
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.hover.text: A new action makes the nearest container with the hovered item glow and closes the menu in one key press. It ships unbound so it never clashes with your keys.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.hover.how.1: Bind “Find hovered item” on the Controls page, for example to G.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.hover.how.2: Hover an item in any inventory and press the key.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.settings.title: Native settings
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.settings.text: Settings are now Stow's own screen with a search box, task categories, a changed marker and per-row reset. Changes apply at once and Ctrl+Z undoes the last one. Keep amounts and Controls are part of it. Cloth Config is no longer required.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.settings.how.1: Open it from Mod Menu, the gear in Stow, or by typing “settings”.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.settings.how.2: Your existing settings.json is kept as it is.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.arrange.title: Arrange every HUD element
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.arrange.text: One editor now places Project totals, Building stock, the Equipment HUD and the new Automation status. Drag, nudge with the arrow keys, snap to the centre or margins and see a warning when an element overlaps the hotbar or another element.
stow.whatsnew.1_1_0.arrange.how.2: Nothing changes until you press Save.
